title: Calculate NLO loop corrections to ALP decay vertices and amplitudes
description: Using the fixed power counting, derive and evaluate one-loop corrections to direct ALP-meson and ALP-resonance vertices in the selected priority decay channels, in addition to the two-point effects. Include vertex and external-leg terms required for renormalization and LSZ consistency, absorptive thresholds and finite nonanalytic pieces; identify local NLO counterterms and demonstrate scale cancellation in physical amplitudes. Do not claim a complete NLO decay prediction from corrected masses and mixing alone. Select channels and loop topologies according to the declared expansion and available inputs.
acceptance_criteria: For selected ALP decay channels the complete declared-order loop contribution, counterterms, external-leg factors, nonanalytic parts and scale cancellation are derived and validated; omitted channels/topologies and truncation are explicit.

title: Propagate NLO masses and mixing into ALP decay amplitudes
description: Replace LO pseudoscalar pole masses and mixing assumptions in affected ALP processes with the NLO loop-corrected pole eigenvectors and residues, transforming direct ALP vertices consistently so physical amplitudes remain field-coordinate invariant. Identify which existing ALP channels are affected, avoid double counting resonance-saturated local pieces, and quantify the change and uncertainty relative to LO. Include process-level loop corrections only when they belong to the declared NLO counting and are calculated consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Affected ALP amplitudes use the NLO pole masses, mixing and residues consistently with direct vertices; predictions document channel coverage, loop/local matching, numerical inputs, uncertainties and comparison to LO.

title: Implement the renormalized NLO resonance propagator and pole solver
description: Implement the full two-point matrices, one-loop functions, renormalized local terms, explicit resonance blocks and physical pole/mixing/residue solver in deterministic repository code. Use analytic expressions where available, stable numerical evaluation near thresholds, explicit units and scheme/scale metadata, and efficient reuse of mass-dependent loop functions. Support literature and fitted parameter sets with covariance propagation. Validate limits against the existing quadratic matrices, explicit pseudoscalar-resonance Schur complement, scale cancellation and independent numerical pole solutions.
acceptance_criteria: A documented efficient implementation evaluates renormalized NLO inverse propagators and physical masses/mixing/residues with uncertainty propagation and passes analytic-limit, scale-dependence, threshold and independent-solver checks.

title: Determine NLO and resonance numerical inputs from literature and fits
description: After the loop, saturation and pole equations are derived, assemble a convention-consistent numerical input set: quark masses and leading parameters, renormalized U(3) NLO LECs at a stated scale, resonance masses/couplings and widths, singlet/topological parameters, and relevant decay constants/form factors. Prefer compatible literature determinations; otherwise fit to pseudoscalar masses, decay constants, mixing-sensitive radiative/strong decays and resonance data. Document correlations, data selection, scheme conversion, parameter identifiability, fit quality, residuals and theory truncation. Do not fit parameters whose contribution vanishes or is exactly degenerate in the derived observables.
acceptance_criteria: All numerical inputs required by the pole and ALP calculations have cited literature values or reproducible fits with units, conventions, scale/scheme, covariance, goodness-of-fit and identifiability; unconstrained directions are explicit.

title: Solve physical pseudoscalar poles, masses, mixing and LSZ residues at NLO
description: Combine LO and renormalized local NLO quadratic terms, loop self-energies, and explicit resonance blocks into the full momentum-dependent inverse propagator. Determine physical pi0, eta and eta-prime pole masses, mixing eigenvectors and residues with isospin breaking and singlet dynamics; include ALP-meson mixing consistently where requested. Use exact coupled-block diagonalization near degeneracies and strict-order perturbation elsewhere, and compare with measured masses/decay observables without using LO mixing as the physical answer.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible pole solver returns masses, mixing and residues with uncertainty and scheme/truncation dependence; it reduces to the existing tree NLO and explicit-resonance limits and documents near-degenerate treatment.

title: Match resonance saturation to every quadratic NLO term without double counting
description: Give a term-by-term derivation comparing the full quadratic U(3) NLO Lagrangian with exchange of explicit resonance fields. For scalar and pseudoscalar resonances, derive the induced kinetic and mass operators including vacuum shifts and bilinear pseudoscalar-Goldstone mixing; for vector and axial resonances show which quadratic operators they do or do not generate at the declared order. Treat Lambda_1, Lambda_2, L_18, L_25 and ALP/topological-source terms explicitly rather than assuming standard SU(3) saturation fixes them. Compare local low-energy expansions of exchange with the coupled propagating-field description; specify matching scale, subtraction of the explicit pole part, residual local LECs and loop pieces so no contribution is counted twice. Recover the NLO neutral mass and mixing matrices in the low-energy limit.
acceptance_criteria: An executable, coefficient-by-coefficient matching accounts for all quadratic LECs and singlet/source structures, states which are saturated, unconstrained or zero at this order, reproduces the low-energy quadratic Hessian, and provides a no-double-counting prescription with scale dependence.

title: Calculate NLO loop self-energies and ALP-meson two-point functions
description: Evaluate the one-loop two-point functions from the chosen leading U(3)+resonance Lagrangian, including Goldstone and any resonance loops required by the declared counting. Derive the momentum-dependent pseudoscalar self-energy matrix, mixed ALP-meson blocks, wavefunction derivatives and allowed absorptive thresholds. Subtract UV divergences in the selected scheme and demonstrate cancellation against renormalized local NLO constants. Keep nonanalytic pieces explicit and distinguish perturbative NLO pole shifts from any resummation used near thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Renormalized loop self-energies and mixed two-point functions are derived or numerically evaluated with counterterm cancellation, threshold structure, pole-residue contributions and a controlled NLO/resummation prescription.

title: Fix combined U(3) NLO and resonance power counting and renormalization
description: Define the field content, operator basis, chiral and 1/Nc counting, subtraction scheme and renormalization scale for a theory with the pseudoscalar nonet plus explicit scalar, pseudoscalar, vector and axial resonances. Specify which Goldstone and resonance loops enter at the target order, which counterterms absorb their divergences, and how the existing local U(3) constants and ALP-source operators are renormalized. Treat singlet/topological constants separately where their matching or running differs from standard SU(3). State the energy range and truncation uncertainty.
acceptance_criteria: A consistent combined power counting and renormalized operator basis specifies included/excluded loop classes, counterterms, scale/scheme dependence, singlet-source treatment and validity range.

title: Build a loop-complete NLO U(3) chiral theory with dynamical resonances
description: Construct a renormalized framework that extends the project's LO U(3) ChiPT so pseudoscalar masses and mixing patterns can be described beyond LO while scalar, pseudoscalar, vector and axial resonance fields remain explicit dynamical degrees of freedom. Include the NLO local Lagrangian, Goldstone and resonance loop effects at a declared power counting, coupled two-point functions, and a detailed resonance-saturation derivation for the quadratic NLO terms. State how explicit resonance exchange is separated from local LEC contributions to prevent double counting, and how loop renormalization-scale dependence is canceled. Apply the resulting masses, mixing eigenvectors and residues consistently to ALP sources and amplitudes. Acceptance requires executable derivations and reproducible numerical implementation with documented inputs, schemes, validity limits and uncertainty.
acceptance_criteria: A renormalized loop-complete NLO framework with explicit dynamical resonance fields yields physical pseudoscalar masses and mixing eigenvectors/residues beyond LO; its quadratic resonance-saturation matching is derived term by term without double counting; reproducible code propagates the corrected poles and LSZ mixing into ALP processes with controlled inputs and uncertainties.

title: Integrate axial fields and inputs into reproducible ALP code
description: Implement the derived even/odd axial RChT vertices, propagators or spectral functions, flavor/mixing data and process-level APIs. Use the analytical process amplitudes to limit fit parameters to relevant identifiable coefficients/directions, and then ingest the sourced literature inputs or fitted results from the numerical-input ledger. Make inputs explicit, provenance-tagged and unit-checked; support covariance/profile samples and retain vector-only comparison mode. Cache reusable flavor and kinematic structures. Validate against analytical limits, symmetries, existing predictions with axial couplings off, and calibration data.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic documented implementation evaluates analytically derived supported external-axial and exchange processes from explicit literature or fitted inputs, excludes irrelevant fit directions, propagates uncertainties, and passes focused validation with axial contributions off and on.

title: Add axial exchange to existing ALP decay amplitudes
description: First derive axial-resonance exchange and required local matching terms analytically in each existing ALP process where allowed, auditing a→3P, a→γPP, a→VPP, a→4P, photon/TFF channels and other repository processes rather than presuming contributions. Establish selection rules, coherent amplitudes, representation-equivalent contacts, Ward identities, Bose/crossing symmetry and dependence on even/odd coefficients before any fit. Then use the input-ledger bead to source or fit only relevant parameters and propagate their uncertainties. Include widths/spectral functions where required.
acceptance_criteria: An analytical process-by-process allowed/forbidden map and amplitudes identify all relevant coefficient combinations and matching contacts; only afterward are needed numerical inputs sourced/fitted. Nonzero channels have validation and uncertainty; zero channels have selection-rule evidence.

title: Derive ALP decays with axial mesons in the final state
description: First derive and enumerate the analytically allowed ALP decays with an axial meson treated as an external narrow state, such as a→Aγ and a→AP, plus any multi-hadron modes supported by the selected basis. Obtain amplitudes, flavor/charge selection rules, widths, thresholds, interference, and explicit dependence on even/odd coefficients before selecting numerical fit parameters. Treat broad axial resonances through daughter states and spectral distributions unless a stated narrow-width approximation is justified. Numerical values and fits follow from the coefficient-dependence analysis in the input-ledger bead.
acceptance_criteria: All supported stable/narrow axial-meson final-state channels are enumerated and derived with selection rules, widths, sourced/fitted numerical inputs and explicit narrow-width validity; broad-state channels are represented through physical decay products or excluded with reason.

title: Identify relevant coefficients and determine axial-sector numerical inputs
description: After the even/odd Lagrangians and analytical ALP process amplitudes are established, make a process-by-process coefficient-dependence map. Use the derived amplitudes and their Jacobians to identify coefficients or directions that vanish, are redundant, or are irrelevant to the selected ALP observables; exclude those directions from fits unless independent physics requires them. For every relevant process list needed masses, widths/line shapes, mixing matrices, decay constants, strong/radiative couplings, odd/even RChT coefficients, phases and correlations. Source inputs from primary literature and established averages where compatible; for missing quantities define datasets, observables, fit parameters, degeneracies/null directions and validation criteria. Record exact conventions, units, uncertainties and kinematic validity, distinguishing literature values, fit results and assumptions. Include shared vector-fit inputs only where the derived amplitudes actually depend on them.
acceptance_criteria: The ledger follows completed analytical amplitudes and maps each process to its genuinely relevant coefficients and numerical inputs; irrelevant/null directions are documented and excluded from fits as appropriate; literature inputs and fitted values have sources, conventions, uncertainties/covariances, while missing inputs have an explicit fit plan and identifiability criteria.

title: Construct the odd-parity axial-meson operators and anomaly matching
description: Enumerate the odd-intrinsic-parity operators involving axial resonances, Goldstones, photons/external currents, vector resonances and ALP sources at the selected truncation. Match anomaly and short-distance constraints where applicable, keep independent local terms explicit, and check photon Ward identities, charge conjugation, parity and Bose symmetry. Relate conventions to existing vector odd-parity operators without assuming vector-only prescriptions extend automatically to axial mesons.
acceptance_criteria: A complete declared odd-parity axial operator basis and source/current matching is derived, with redundant structures, free coefficients, anomaly constraints and executable checks documented.

title: Define the even-parity axial-meson RChT sector
description: Choose and document the axial-vector field representation and flavor basis, kinetic and mass terms, nonideal mixing, and complete even-parity operators needed for ALP couplings and strong/electromagnetic decays. Derive the relevant A-P, A-V, A-Goldstone and source vertices, including field redefinitions and induced local terms required for equivalence between representations. Separate symmetry-fixed relations from independent couplings and define the power counting and width treatment.
acceptance_criteria: A convention-complete even-parity axial RChT Lagrangian and executable vertex derivations cover the channels in the process inventory, with all independent coefficients and induced contacts identified.

title: Build axial-meson resonance chiral theory and implement ALP applications
description: Develop a reproducible RChT treatment of axial-vector mesons covering both even-parity and odd-parity interactions, then determine their ALP-decay contributions. Sequence: (1) establish the even/odd operator sectors; (2) derive and simplify analytically every ALP process with stable/narrow axial external states and every allowed axial-exchange contribution to existing processes; (3) use those amplitudes to map relevant coefficient combinations, identify zero/redundant/unobservable directions, and only then source literature values or fit the remaining parameters; (4) implement and validate the numerical predictions. Include both external axial final states and exchange corrections. Record numerical inputs with conventions, units, sources, covariance/uncertainty, kinematic domain and stable-state/width validity. Broad axial resonances are not asymptotic states unless a justified narrow-width approximation applies. Preserve Ward identities, crossing, representation-matching contacts and no-mixing ALP source conventions. Do not import conditional vector-fit results as established axial-sector inputs; use shared vector-fit parameters only where the derived amplitudes show an actual dependence.
acceptance_criteria: A documented axial-meson RChT even/odd basis is derived and implemented; every ALP process with axial external states or axial exchange is inventoried; each process has a sourced and uncertainty-qualified numerical-input set from literature or an explicit fit; reproducible predictions are provided within stated validity limits, with missing inputs and excluded channels recorded.

title: Compute a→ℓ+ℓ− from the completed doubly virtual TFF
description: Insert the TFF into the full two-photon lepton-loop functional for electron, muon and tau where kinematically open. Include real and absorptive parts, open hadronic cuts, finite lepton-mass effects, coherent local ALP-lepton terms under a declared matching convention, and uncertainty components. The pointlike limit and two-photon cut are checks, not replacements for the full result. The kernel, normalization and modular interface can proceed independently; numerical predictions depend on the TFF library, its high-energy completion and hadronic inputs. Vector-fit-driven central values/covariances additionally depend on alp-uzh.8.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible widths or branching fractions and uncertainty breakdown are produced over a declared mass/coupling domain, with all open cuts and local-term assumptions stated and pointlike/two-photon-cut checks satisfied.

title: Implement an efficient source-linear doubly virtual TFF library
description: Implement the TFF provider and its numerical integrations in repository scripts/library code using the documented no-mixing source basis and unnormalized scalar convention. Reuse precomputed source responses, vector/spectral grids and interpolation or quadrature structures; avoid recomputing source-independent kernels for each coupling choice. Provide deterministic units, domains, error propagation, minimal invocation examples and validation against limits, symmetry, Ward identities, pointlike behavior and high-energy matching. The API and structural code can proceed with symbolic or injectable inputs; calibrated numerical predictions and fit covariance depend on alp-uzh.8 and the low/high-energy TFF children.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible efficient implementation evaluates source-linear TFFs and declared uncertainties, documents its API and limitations, and passes focused numerical/analytic consistency checks.

title: Derive and match the ALP-specific high-energy TFF completion
description: Derive source-basis short-distance behavior for both virtualities from the appropriate ALP QCD matrix elements and OPE/light-cone expansion. Determine matching scales and scheme, finite-m_a corrections and flavor-threshold treatment; match to the low-energy representation without double counting and assess alternative completions. The ALP asymptotic coefficient must not be borrowed from eta/eta-prime. This work is independent of the numerical vector-meson fit at the derivation stage; matching to a fit-calibrated low-energy representation depends on alp-6os.1.
acceptance_criteria: The high-energy TFF behavior and source-dependent coefficients are derived with provenance, schemes, thresholds and uncertainty; a tested matching prescription joins it to the low-energy form without double counting.

title: Assemble low-energy doubly virtual TFF spectra and match vector poles
description: Complete the source-resolved low-energy TFF from the existing two-pion, three-pion, kaon, omega/phi and mixed rho-isoscalar work. Supply missing complex production/current inputs and uncertainty variations; define a single-counting prescription where the dressed rho pole overlaps the two-pion continuum and where narrow omega/phi poles meet their cuts. Include higher isoscalar strength or document its bounded omission and the supported domain. Structural derivation and input acquisition can proceed without an accepted vector-sector fit; numerical resonance calibration and fit-driven uncertainty propagation depend on alp-uzh.8, which itself follows fit convergence and identifiability. Do not use the current nonconverged fit as validated input.
acceptance_criteria: Source-specific spectral densities and pole terms have explicit conventions, inputs, complex phases, cut normalization, overlap matching, uncertainty provenance, and a declared low-energy domain; missing inputs are either obtained or recorded as concrete blockers.

title: Complete the source-resolved doubly virtual ALP TFF and applications
description: Build a controlled, reproducible prediction for the ALP transition form factor with two virtual photons, then provide its lepton-pair and related phenomenological applications. The current tree-level neutral-vector expression and partial low-energy dispersive inputs are not a complete TFF: source-specific spectra, overlap matching, higher hadronic strength, and the ALP-specific high-energy completion remain open. Keep the no-mixing source basis, unnormalized TFF convention, and uncertainty/model limits explicit. Organize the work as child beads for the hadronic construction, high-energy completion, numerical software, a→ℓ+ℓ−, a→γℓ+ℓ−, and an astrophysical applicability assessment. Acceptance: source-resolved doubly virtual TFF with declared domain, cut and pole matching, short-distance behavior, reproducible implementation and uncertainty accounting; applications implemented or explicitly ruled out where inputs are insufficient. Vector-fit dependency: only the TFF numerical calibration/uncertainty task depends on the accepted numerical vector fit; the current fit is nonconverged/model-inadequate, so use no fit central values as validated inputs. Structural derivations, software architecture, and applications that accept a TFF provider can proceed without that fit.
acceptance_criteria: An indexed, source-resolved doubly virtual ALP TFF has a declared low/high-energy construction, matched poles and cuts, ALP-specific short-distance completion, reproducible implementation, stated uncertainties and supported kinematic domain; requested applications are computed from it or have evidence-based scope limits.

title: Implement high-order KKπ quadrature convergence plan
description: Implement converge-kkpi-quadrature-chi2: deterministic energy-bin block evaluation matching the full-grid path, focused tests, run all five saved points through pair/angular order 128, store and replay results, and update alp-uzh.2 only if every point passes.

title: Assess joint-fit goodness and model sensitivity
description: Using a converged, numerically certified minimum, assess per-block residuals and fit adequacy. Quantify justified variations in fit window, resonance inputs, tensor contribution, source hypothesis, mass prescription, and covariance treatment. If the retained model remains inadequate, identify the specific physics/model extension needed before accepting parameter estimates.
acceptance_criteria: The joint fit has a documented goodness-of-fit assessment and sensitivity study, with an adequate description or a concrete model failure and follow-up issue.

title: Obtain converged joint vector-sector minima
description: After quadrature certification and the shared even-sector audit, refit the same raw likelihood with documented parameter scaling and multiple physically permitted starts. Preserve competing solutions and termination details; do not report a fit as accepted solely because an optimizer returns parameter values.
acceptance_criteria: At least one successful, reproducible minimum is stable under numerical refinement, with bounds, branches, residuals, and optimizer diagnostics recorded.

title: Audit shared even-sector and G_V constraints
description: Diagnose tension in the shared even-sector and conditional G_V measurement block. Audit input provenance, charged/neutral mass prescriptions, shared widths and duplicated measurements, K* to K pi saturation, and covariance assumptions; compare only physically justified alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible blockwise diagnosis quantifies the tension and its effect on the joint likelihood and documents justified retained data/model assumptions.

title: Certify KKpi quadrature and likelihood derivatives
description: Certify the energy-bin and two-dimensional Dalitz integrations, including narrow phi and K*(892) structures, for representative points spanning the fitted region. Compare predictions, residuals, derivatives, and chi-square under independent quadrature refinement before interpreting optimizer or profile results.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible refinement results show prediction and likelihood changes below stated tolerances relative to experimental uncertainties, with stored orders, points, and invocation.
notes: The first reproducible run at orders (2,16,16) to (4,32,32) left all five points uncertified; it remains preserved as data/vector_sector/kkpi_quadrature_certification.json. Follow-up high-order qualification uses energy 2→4, pair 64→128, angular 64→128, and combined (2,64,64)→(4,128,128), reusing the same five saved points. All five pass every unchanged tolerance; the saved invocation replay reproduced all point vectors, comparisons, outcomes, counts, orders, and input/source hashes. Evidence: data/vector_sector/kkpi_quadrature_certification_high_order.json. Quadrature acceptance is met at the recorded points/orders; this does not certify optimizer convergence or fit quality.
close_reason: Recorded high-order quadrature refinement certifies all five representative points and replay provenance; optimizer and fit quality remain explicitly outside scope.

title: Reconcile the joint vector fit baseline and likelihood
description: Distinguish the earlier BaBar-only coefficient fit from the preliminary + conditional G_V + BaBar global likelihood. Inventory all measurement rows, shared nuisances, coefficient coordinates, source/mass conventions, covariance assumptions, excluded duplicate inputs, and the authoritative script/artifact. The current global artifact reports success=false, chi2=307.985 for 43 dof, and exhausted its function-evaluation budget; do not conflate this with the older BaBar-only chi2=35.7164/29 fit.
acceptance_criteria: An indexed record identifies the authoritative joint likelihood and script, lists its data blocks and assumptions, and records its current nonconvergence and poor fit status.
close_reason: Indexed record documents the authoritative joint likelihood and script, inventories its data blocks and assumptions, and records the nonconverged poor-fit baseline; no new fit is in scope.

title: Complete the joint vector-meson Lagrangian fit
description:
Bring the preliminary odd-sector, conditional G_V, and BaBar inputs into one validated fit of the retained vector-meson Lagrangian. The current global artifact is nonconverged and model-inadequate, so coefficient values and local errors are not accepted results. Track the remaining numerical, data-model, identifiability, and export steps as dependent issues.

acceptance_criteria: A reproducible, converged and statistically assessed joint fit is available, with supported coefficient combinations and uncertainties, explicit null directions, and indexed documentation of its inputs and limitations.

title: Assess astrophysical uses and limits of the ALP TFF
description: Assess whether the completed TFF can support astrophysical production, absorption or energy-loss calculations, and identify the required plasma, medium, stellar, cosmological and coupling inputs. Distinguish vacuum decay form factors from in-medium photon propagation and scattering; calculate only applications whose additional inputs and approximations are controlled. Record mass/coupling domains, uncertainty propagation, and concrete missing inputs for any deferred application. The scope assessment and modular interfaces are independent of the vector fit; numerical predictions that use fit-calibrated TFF responses depend on alp-uzh.8.
acceptance_criteria: A sourced applicability assessment identifies viable observables, required external inputs, controlled approximations and exclusions; any selected prediction is reproducible and uncertainty-qualified.

title: Compute a→γℓ+ℓ− with the singly virtual ALP TFF
description: Construct the source-resolved singly virtual form factor and calculate the Dalitz decay a→γℓ+ℓ− with its differential and integrated distributions, lepton threshold, photon cuts where relevant, and uncertainties. Check normalization against a→γγ and consistently handle resonance regions and the real-photon limit. A modular rate implementation can be developed independently, but numerical predictions require the TFF inputs; vector-fit-calibrated predictions and their covariance depend on alp-uzh.8.
acceptance_criteria: Differential and integrated rates with declared cuts, conventions, uncertainties, mass domain and real-photon normalization checks are reproducibly available.

title: Record loop-corrected ALP-meson LSZ mixing
description: Add an indexed research note explaining one-loop mixed two-point functions and their contribution to the ALP-meson LSZ overlap in the existing K, M2, C pole and w conventions. Include a reproducible symbolic block-matrix derivation script and distinguish general structure from uncomputed source-specific integrals.
close_reason: Added indexed loop-corrected ALP-meson LSZ derivation and executed its SymPy script.

title: Document one-loop effects in NLO U(3) quadratic Lagrangian
description: Add a source-backed memory note covering loop contributions at NLO beyond the renormalized local LECs, and state the renormalized LEC combinations entering the retained quadratic Lagrangian. Update the NLO index.
close_reason: Added indexed NLO memory note covering one-loop structure and quadratic-sector renormalized constants.

title: Plan higher-order KKπ quadrature convergence after chi-square tolerance failure
description: Create a new OpenSpec proposal grounded in the stored KKπ certification failure, focused on enabling sufficient higher pair/angular quadrature orders and meeting the chi-square tolerance without changing the likelihood definition.

title: Implement reproducible KKπ fitted-region certification (Tasks 2.1–2.3)
description: Complete OpenSpec section 2 of certify-kkpi-quadrature-likelihood-derivatives: deterministic reference/competing/displacement points, complete machine-readable result with invocation and provenance, and representative quadrature certification run with stored evidence including explicit uncertified outcomes where needed.

title: Add KKπ quadrature failure-diagnostic tests (Task 1.2)
description: Implement OpenSpec Task 1.2 in certify-kkpi-quadrature-likelihood-derivatives: add tests for pole-aware phi/Kstar integration, failed maximum-order convergence, and invalid sampled points; verify focused certification suite passes and preserves failure diagnostics.

title: Implement independent KKπ quadrature certification comparisons (Task 1.1)
description: Implement OpenSpec Task 1.1 in certify-kkpi-quadrature-likelihood-derivatives: independently refine energy, pair, and angular integration orders; compare predictions, standardized residuals, Jacobian columns, and χ² to declared tolerances with explicit pass/failure; add focused tests for independent dimension variation and each comparison outcome.

title: Improve runtime of global BaBar KKπ vector-sector fit
description: The script scripts/fit_babar_kkpi_global_vector_sector.py currently takes nearly an hour to complete, making iteration and reproducibility checks costly. Profile the fit, identify its dominant runtime costs, and improve efficiency while preserving the likelihood, numerical accuracy, and reported fit diagnostics. Record before/after runtime under comparable settings and verify the optimized results against the current implementation.
close_reason: Optimized propagator and Jacobian evaluation; final fit is 60% faster with bitwise-identical outputs and regression coverage.

title: Select additional observables for unconstrained coefficient directions
description: Use the accepted fit's profiled coefficient null space to assess source-backed differential KKpi, three-pion, Dalitz, or transition-form-factor observables that could constrain remaining Lagrangian combinations. For each candidate account for model adequacy, experimental projection, covariance, and nuisance profiling before adding data to the likelihood.
acceptance_criteria: A ranked candidate-observable study quantifies new coefficient sensitivity after nuisance profiling and records selected inputs/predictors as dependent follow-up work; no unvalidated observable is added to the fit.

title: Export and document the accepted vector Lagrangian fit
description: Publish only supported even-sector parameters and odd-coefficient combinations from the accepted joint fit, with conventions, nuisance treatment, correlations or profile intervals, and remaining null directions. Any original c_i,d_i,g_i representative must be explicitly arbitrary along unmeasured directions.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible parameter export and indexed research record are generated from the accepted fit and clearly separate measured combinations from representative-dependent coefficients.

title: Certify coefficient identifiability and profile intervals
description: For an accepted joint likelihood, determine the coefficient null space after profiling nuisance parameters and compute nonlinear profiles for measurable combinations. Inspect discrete sign solutions, bounds, and optimizer convergence at each profile point. Do not infer confidence intervals from local Hessian errors or uncertified quadratic profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Rank thresholds and singular values, explicit null certificates, converged profile points, and intervals with established crossings are reproducibly recorded; uncertified directions remain labeled unmeasured.
